g.text: Plug-flow reactor volume is the area under a reciprocal-rate curve

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Isothermal first-order reaction k=0.20 min⁻¹, inlet C_A0=2 mol/L, constant volumetric flow q=1 L/min, F_A0=2 mol/min. Ideal plug flow has no axial mixing.
Area units L·min/mol multiplied by mol/min give litres; volume is8.047 L. Pressure drop and heat effects omitted.
